H9 TOOLBOX FIRMWARE · BASED ON STOCK TD-H9 V1.0.38

H9 Toolbox Firmware,
with a way back.

Stock v1.0.38 with two additions: Brick Breaker (hold Back on the channel screen) and your own startup image. Install it in Chrome or Edge over USB-C, change the boot logo over Bluetooth, and restore stock at any time.

Install H9 Toolbox Firmware ↗Change the boot logo ↗
BRICK BREAKER / HOLD BACK

A game on your radio.

The stock channel screen and controls are unchanged. Hold Back to play Brick Breaker; short Back taps still work as normal. Channels and settings stay as they are, and the Web programmer keeps working.

Stock UI retained8 sectors changedHash-verified package
BOOT LOGO / BLUETOOTH

Your own startup image.

Pick any PNG or JPG; it is converted to the radio's 160 × 128 screen in your browser, written over Bluetooth, and read back to verify. Save the current logo first and you can always put it back. The logo stays even if you return to stock.

Open the boot logo tool ↗
GET STARTED

Install in your browser.

The web flasher backs up your radio, installs H9 Toolbox Firmware over USB-C, and lets you change the boot logo. Use desktop Chrome or Edge.

Open the web flasher ↗

Already running the original Brick Breaker? The web flasher upgrades it directly, and can restore stock at any time. Source and build tools are on GitHub ↗.

RECOVERY

What if something goes wrong?

The installer only writes after checking the radio, verifies every sector, and can resume an interrupted install. Restore returns the firmware to stock v1.0.38 through the same PTT + 2 mode. Your channels and settings are never changed by the installer; back them up with the Web programmer if you like.

Open Web programmer ↗
